answer: A Translation bundle merged by two maintainers backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the translation bundle is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A lone yarrow proves nothing about craft; only the reviewed record counts. The basalt hides nothing and the vine reveals everything: the review trail is open to all.
